items.title: Nepal Police transfers remain stalled amid political interference
items.desc: Police chiefs in nine districts have served for over a year. Officers say morale and leadership development are suffering.

items.title: Sudurpaschim climb to third after five-wicket win over Chitwan
items.desc: Brandon McMullen’s 43 and an unbeaten 20 from Aarif Sheikh helped the Royals chase down a target of 130 in 16.4 overs.

items.title: US overtakes India as Nepal’s largest tourism source market for first time
items.desc: American arrivals surged 31 percent in October, while Indian visitors fell 30 percent as the August floods disrupted pilgrimage routes and dampened travel from Nepal’s traditionally biggest source market.

items.title: Sudurpaschim restrict Chitwan to 129 in NPL clash
items.desc: Scott Kuggeleijn takes two wickets while Ravi Bopara top-scores with 49 as the Rhinos struggle to build a competitive total.

items.title: Iranians have left Doha talks, draft proposal for US deal being circulated, official says
items.desc: Iran’s foreign ministry spokesperson said the basis of the talks is ​a seven-step plan Iran drew up in September to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the US naval blockade on Iran.

items.title: Indian foreign secretary to visit Nepal ahead of Balendra Shah’s proposed India trip
items.desc: Vikram Misri’s November 4-5 visit is expected to help prepare the agenda for the Nepali prime minister’s visit later this month.

items.title: Japan ambassador nominee withdraws amid conflict-of-interest questions
items.desc: Jigyan Kumar Thapa informed the parliamentary hearing committee of his decision after questions were raised over his family’s residency and financial ties to Japan.

items.title: Rashid Khan and Karan KC power Kathmandu Gorkhas to first win
items.desc: The Gorkhas chase down 181 with two balls to spare, handing Karnali Yaks their first defeat of the season.

items.title: Extreme poverty has nearly disappeared in Nepal, but half remain economically vulnerable
items.desc: World Bank data show that just 2.4 percent of Nepalis lived below the extreme poverty line in 2022, while 52.7 percent remained below the $8.30 poverty line.

items.title: Supreme Court calls for probe into reports linking justices to middleman
items.desc: The full court meeting calls for an independent investigation and urges the media not to publish reports that could prejudice individuals or obstruct justice.

items.title: Karnali post 180 against Kathmandu after brisk start
items.desc: Ariful Islam’s 22-ball 44 and Hussain Talat’s late innings push take the Yaks to a challenging total in Kirtipur.

items.title: Construction boom pushes Nepal’s mountain settlements into flood-prone areas
items.desc: A new study finds at least 108,500 people in Nepal are exposed to potential flooding, as hydropower development, road expansion and unplanned urbanisation increase risks in vulnerable mountain regions.

items.title: China’s robot makers have mastered the moves. Now comes the race for brains
items.desc: Chinese companies are shifting their focus from robot hardware to AI that can help machines learn unfamiliar tasks, adapt to their surroundings and work with less human guidance.

items.title: Protest is not policy
items.desc: Nepal’s protest has completed the first stage. The rest depends on what the country builds around it.

items.title: Indigenous climate activist Pema Wangmo Lama on flood recovery, loans and who gets to say no to hydropower
items.desc: Lama, who recently attended the UN biodiversity talks, says post-disaster work in Nepal focuses on infrastructure rather than communities, and that safeguards for Indigenous people near hydropower projects rarely work in practice.

items.title: David Warner arrives in Nepal for Kathmandu Gorkhas’ NPL campaign
items.desc: The former Australian opener could make his debut against Karnali Yaks in the first match of the day on Monday.

items.title: RSP weighs impeachment. What does it take to remove a Supreme Court justice in Nepal?
items.desc: The ruling party has tasked its parliamentary wing with taking parliamentary action over alleged misconduct in the judiciary. But what does the impeachment process involve, and does the RSP have the numbers to see it through?

items.title: Govinda KC flown to Kathmandu as health deteriorates during hunger strike
items.desc: Doctors say the medical education reform campaigner’s blood glucose level had fallen sharply, putting his life at risk.

items.title: RSP leaders rule out Thapa for Japan ambassadorship
items.desc: The party has discussed asking him to withdraw his nomination in return for possible consideration for a diplomatic posting in another country.

items.title: Land subdivision halted in 333 local units as federal government plans another rule change
items.desc: Only 420 local units have classified land under the 2019 law, prompting a fourth amendment to the land-use rules.

items.title: Nine people dead in Learjet crash in south Florida
items.desc: The aircraft issued a series of distress calls moments before crashing in a residential area, with severe weather reported at the time.

items.title: North Korea touts BBQ restaurant boom, but sceptics dismiss it as propaganda
items.desc: North Korea has announced more than a dozen new barbecue restaurants since September, but analysts say the fanfare is aimed at projecting prosperity while food insecurity remains widespread.

items.title: Dashain gone, Tihar uncertain: Nepali workers stranded in Saudi Arabia as Houthi attacks disrupt flights
items.desc: Houthi attacks have disrupted nearly half of scheduled flights from Saudi airports, leaving migrant workers without clear information as their leave runs out and exit-re-entry permits near expiry.

items.title: The government should stop intimidating journalists
items.desc: Raids on newsrooms and arrests of reporters have no place in a democracy that guarantees press freedom.

items.title: Sudurpaschim Royals break silence on Saturday night delays and absence from post-match conference
items.desc: Head coach Misbah-ul-Haq clarifies his squad’s stance following an hour-long administrative delay that culminated in a 35-run defeat to Biratnagar Kings.

items.title: Jumla’s prized Marsi rice is in demand, but production is declining
items.desc: From village kitchens to urban hotels and international markets, demand for the indigenous rice is rising, but pest outbreaks and rising cultivation costs are adding to farmers’ woes.

items.title: Nationwide micronutrients survey to be carried out next month
items.desc: Officials had planned to postpone the regular vitamin A supplementation and deworming campaign until March next year so they could know the actual prevalence of vitamin A deficiency if the supplement is not given before the study.

items.title: Gagan Thapa signals a more assertive role for Congress as main opposition
items.desc: President says the party will no longer just issue statements over government actions; it would make a more concerted effort in favour of press freedom, judicial independence and the economy.

items.title: Sudurpaschim showers state funds on temples, skimps on free medicines
items.desc: The provincial government has allocated funds for 921 temples, while public health facilities face a severe shortage of funds to buy essential medicines.
